nodes.label: OpenCode DevKit
nodes.rationale: A modular AI-assisted development layer for analyzing, auditing, and optimizing OpenCode configurations. Designed to be a concrete, phased web application rather than a generic utility.

nodes.label: JSON Config Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Core feature: upload/paste an opencode.json file, receive security risk analysis, missing-options suggestions with 'Learn more' links, and a diff of modifications.

nodes.label: Phase I — Initialization
nodes.rationale: Phase I sets up the project skeleton: /init, create directories, install packages, create venv. No production code yet.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md (Project)
nodes.rationale: Stripped from 186 to 69 lines to focus on high-signal project guidance: stack, phase, key files, venv, conventions, recommended skills. Follows 'ask, don't guess' and 'document sync' principles.

nodes.label: knowledge/ Directory
nodes.rationale: Read-only copies of official OpenCode docs serving as the knowledge base for all app features. Do not edit.

nodes.label: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.rationale: Session-by-session changes log for easy review of progress and context recovery after long pauses.

nodes.label: DECISIONS.md
nodes.rationale: Very valuable: records WHY design choices were made (e.g. why FastAPI was chosen), preventing model forgetfulness over months.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Rules System (OpenCode)
nodes.rationale: OpenCode's built-in rule system: reads AGENTS.md files from project root, global config, and Claude Code fallbacks. Supports /init command and custom instruction files.

nodes.label: Config Precedence Order
nodes.rationale: Configs merge (not replace) in order: remote → global → custom env → project → .opencode → inline → managed → MDM. Later overrides earlier for conflicting keys only.

nodes.label: Plan Agent (Primary)
nodes.rationale: Restricted agent with edit and bash set to ask by default — designed for analysis and planning without making changes.

nodes.label: Built-in Tools (bash, edit, write, read, grep, glob, etc.)
nodes.norm_label: built-in tools (bash, edit, write, read, grep, glob, etc.)

nodes.label: Document Sync Convention
nodes.rationale: When anything changes, update all affected project docs: AGENTS.md, README.md, TASKS.md, TODO.md, CHANGELOG.md, PHASES.md, etc. Documentation must never lag behind implementation or decisions.
